items.title: Dick Katz interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 7, 2002
items.q: not Bix, because Bix played out you know

ctx.x: Introverted guys who played. And people make a cult out of it. You know what I’m saying? That they’re sort of like — not Bix, because Bix played out you know. But they

were misfits, or whatever the word is now, I mean there’s no question. Because the guys out there making it are like in any other field, they’re asserting themselves on some level big time. And the best example I know of that, I was very privileged to have a front row seat to John Lewis and the MJQ because he was sort of my mentor, teacher, I used to go stay with him and my whole history with him would make an interview.
